content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.110 which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 12 % of the base peak) matches a molecule containing about 12 carbon atoms. The formula C₁₂H₁₆O₂ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 192.115 Da (M+H = 193.122 Da), which is within typical instrument error and fits the observed isotopic distribution better than alternative C/H/O combinations. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₂H₁₆O₂.
